# Maha Strategies LLC

> Independent think tank and advisory firm researching Systemic Sovereignty — how individuals, companies, and nations remain autonomous across the modern stack: semiconductor supply chains (silicon), software and on-device AI (interface), and human biology and attention (intellect). Incorporated in Wyoming, USA; operating from Colombo, Sri Lanka. Founder and Managing Director: Mayone Maha Rajan.

Key facts for machine readers:

- Research is organized in three layers. Infrastructure: semiconductor supply-chain diversification ("China+1"), OSAT feasibility, and the logistics of relocating chip assembly into South Asia. Interface: the shift from cloud-dependent AI to on-device processing, NPU adoption, and digital privacy; applied product, Maha OS. Intellect: cognitive-science-grounded frameworks for attention defense, cognitive liberty, and human resilience.
- Core thesis ("The Sovereign Synthesis"): hardware, software, and the human nervous system are contiguous layers of a single stack; a vulnerability at any layer compromises the others, so independence requires securing all of them.
- Primary doctrine: *The Maha Principle: Reclaiming Biological Sovereignty*, an ~81,000-word non-fiction manuscript by Mayone Maha Rajan (publication pending). Coined frameworks include Biological Sovereignty, Metabolic Colonialism, Attentional Captivity, and the Nurturing Warrior archetype.
- Maha OS is a local-first Android application for focus and metabolic awareness. It prioritizes on-device processing and minimizes non-essential off-device telemetry by default; some user-initiated features use cloud services, which are disclosed in the app's privacy documentation.
- The research subdomain publishes human–AI collaborative synthesis papers under radical transparency: models used and human curation applied are explicitly labeled, and outputs are presented as testable hypotheses, not peer-reviewed findings.

## Protocols (Doctrine Frameworks)

- [Metabolic Sovereignty](https://www.mahastrategies.com/protocols/metabolic-sovereignty): Reclaiming the biological baseline from industrial food systems.
- [The Digital Firewall](https://www.mahastrategies.com/protocols/digital-firewall): Cognitive defense and attention-perimeter design.
- [Kinetic Friction](https://www.mahastrategies.com/protocols/kinetic-friction): Engineered physical resistance as a resilience practice.
- [Hardware Sovereignty](https://www.mahastrategies.com/protocols/hardware-sovereignty): Edge-compute intelligence and local silicon.
- [Architecting Renewal](https://www.mahastrategies.com/protocols/architecting-renewal): The apex framework integrating the preceding protocols.
